content: Extend the W0112 registered-memory lifetime from pinned SG storage to direction-aware DMA mapping through the cdev transport device, with exact map-failure unwind and unmap-before-unpin on unregister, owner close, and module exit.

Committed direction-aware registered-memory SG DMA mapping and reverse-order teardown as a7dfea2. MEMORY_REGISTER now maps through the data cdev DMA device, rejects a missing device or zero mapped segment count before publication, stores direction and mapped count, and unmaps before SG free, dirty-unpin, memlock release, and mmput on every retirement path. Linux 6.18.42 GCC Kbuild passed; full development CTest passed 84/84; git diff --check passed.
